final-post:
Whether it’s karaoke or dating, most people just wait to be chosen.
Truth bomb: You attract great people by becoming someone who steps up, who takes risks, who signs up FIRST.
Put yourself out there. Be brave. Grab the mic.
Remember, confidence is magnetic. You don’t find amazing connections, you create them.
